```{python}
import cellrank as cr
import scanpy as sc
import session_info2
from cellrank.kernels import RealTimeKernel
from moscot.problems.time import TemporalProblem
import scvelo as scv
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

sc.set_figure_params(frameon=False, dpi=100)
cr.settings.logging_level = "INFO"
```

```{python}
carpall = sc.read("carpall_scvi_integrated_annotated.h5ad")
to_remove = ["Early: gdT", "Product"]
carpall = carpall[~carpall.obs["labels"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
pt_df = pd.read_csv("carpall_integrated_slingshot_average_pseudotime.csv", index_col="cell")
carpall.obs["avg_pseudotime"] = pt_df["avg_pseudotime"].reindex(carpall.obs_names)
print(carpall.obs["avg_pseudotime"].isna().sum(), "cells without a value")
sc.pl.umap(carpall, color="avg_pseudotime", legend_loc="on data")
carpall
```


```{python}
pk = cr.kernels.PseudotimeKernel(carpall, time_key="avg_pseudotime")
pk.compute_transition_matrix(threshold_scheme="soft")
```

```{python}
pk.plot_projection(basis="umap", recompute=True)
```

```{python}
g = cr.estimators.GPCCA(pk)
print(g)
```

```{python}
g.compute_schur()
g.plot_spectrum(real_only=True)
```

```{python}
g.compute_macrostates(n_states=7, cluster_key="labels")
g.plot_macrostates(which="all", legend_loc="right", s=50)
```

```{python}
g.plot_macrostate_composition(key="labels", figsize=(7, 4))
```

```{python}
g.plot_coarse_T(annotate=False)
```

```{python}
g.predict_terminal_states()
g.plot_macrostates(which="terminal", legend_loc="right", s=50)
```

```{python}
g.set_initial_states(states=["Early: CD8 TCM_1"], allow_overlap = True)
g.plot_macrostates(which="initial", s=50)
```

```{python}
# write macrostates to AnnData
carpall.obs["macrostates"] = g.macrostates
carpall.uns["macrostates_colors"] = g.macrostates_memberships.colors
```

```{python}
g.compute_fate_probabilities(use_petsc=False)
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=False)
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
```

```{python}
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=True)
```

```{python}
# compute driver genes
early_driver_df = g.compute_lineage_drivers(lineages=["Late: DN T_1", "Mid: CD8 TEM", "Early: CD8 TCM_1"],
cluster_key="labels", clusters = ["Early: CD8 TCM", "Early: CD8 TEM"])


# compute mean gene expression across all cells
carpall.var["mean expression"] = np.asarray(carpall.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
```

```{python}
# visualize in a scatter plot
g.plot_lineage_drivers_correlation(
    lineage_y="Late: DN T_1",
    lineage_x="Mid: CD8 TEM",
    adjust_text=True,
    color="mean expression",
    #gene_sets = genes_oi,
    legend_loc="none",
    figsize=(5, 5),
    dpi=150,
    fontsize=9,
    size=50,
    cmap= "magma"
)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

# Regex matches gene names starting with MT-, RPL, RPS, MRPL, or MRPS (case-insensitive)
pattern = r"^(?:MT-|M?RP[LS])"

mask = ~early_driver_df.index.astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True)
early_driver_df_filtered = early_driver_df[mask]

# Map onto the driver DataFrame by gene name
early_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] = (
    carpall.var.loc[early_driver_df_filtered.index, "mean expression"]
)

early_df_expr = early_driver_df_filtered[early_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] >= 0.1].copy()
early_df_expr["log1p mean expression"] = np.log1p(early_df_expr["mean expression"])
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
sc = ax.scatter(
    x=early_df_expr["Late: DN T_1_corr"],
    y=early_df_expr["Mid: CD8 TEM_corr"],
    c=early_df_expr["log1p mean expression"],
    cmap="magma",
    s=5,
    alpha=0.8,
)
fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label="log1p(mean expression)")

ax.axhline(y=0, color="red", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")  # geom_hline
ax.axvline(x=0, color="red", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")  # geom_vline
ax.set_xlabel("Correlation with DN T fate")
ax.set_ylabel("Correlation with EM CD8+ T fate")
ax.set_title("Driver gene correlations (mean expression >= 0.1)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
